policy: This file is optimization-decision data, not task-card/base facts. Priority labels remain unchanged. A retained package must not be removed by batch P-tier experiments unless the user explicitly requests a re-audit or deletion of that package.

packages.label: 考达拉蓝龙 / 猎龙连续经验链
reason: The chain is a continuous block of quest XP rather than an isolated reward task.
《蓝龙的卵》is low-cost in five-box play: 5 kills for 5 guaranteed Frost Axes, then 5 shared egg interactions.

User field run confirms both 《猎龙》 and 《牢笼》 are five-box shared-progress tasks and are very fast; exact item drop percentages are not needed for five-box repetition because one successful main-character completion advances the group.

Current leveling objective values wall-clock XP efficiency above immediate equipment/gold collection. This package is retained because observed service cost is low relative to its continuous XP chain value.
packages.override_rule: Keep this entire package in the reusable leveling route unless the user explicitly asks to re-audit or remove it. Do not clear or lower the existing P-tier labels; the retention override only blocks automatic deletion.

field_facts.11936: 5 target kills + 5 guaranteed Frost Axes + 5 shared egg interactions; egg progress shared across all five characters.
field_facts.11919: User-confirmed group-shared quest progress: one main-character Nexus Drake capture/return advances all five characters.
field_facts.11943: User-confirmed group-shared item progress: one main-character Energy Core and Prison Casing set advances all five characters; no five-set farming.
